messages.content:
Examine only the attached image pixels. Do not read files, use tools, consult prior sessions, or infer obscured details. This is a Nemesis: Retaliation room tile. Report: ORIENTATION; PRINTED ROOM NAME; every game icon/symbol visible and its location, describing morphology and color before naming it; specifically determine whether any red, yellow, green, or blue Item icon is present and distinguish decorative blue-lit panels from mechanical icons. Mark uncertainty explicitly. Do not modify files.

[Image attached at: /home/smithers/nemesis-retaliation/assets/tts-mod/extract/v2-dl/tree/tiles/room/technical-corridor-entrance-006.jpg]
[screenshot]

ORIENTATION
- The target tile is shown rotated approximately 25–30° clockwise from normal reading orientation. Rotate it counterclockwise by that amount to place the printed text upright.
- In upright orientation, the room name and rules panel occupy the lower portion.

PRINTED ROOM NAME
- TECHNICAL CORRIDOR ENTRANCE

VISIBLE GAME ICONS / SYMBOLS ON THE TARGET TILE
- Upper-left: a large pale cream/white question mark on a dark, outlined metal panel — Question-mark / unknown symbol.
- Upper-right: a thick red circle with a diagonal red slash, over a pale gray angular card/panel-like shape — Prohibition symbol. The exact prohibited object is visually ambiguous.
- Left edge, upper of three: a yellow hexagonal badge containing a white wrench silhouette — yellow Item icon.
- Left edge, middle: a second yellow hexagonal badge containing a white wrench silhouette — yellow Item icon.
- Left edge, lower: a third yellow hexagonal badge containing a white wrench silhouette — yellow Item icon.

ITEM-COLOR DETERMINATION
- Red Item icon: none visible. The red circle-and-slash is a prohibition symbol, not a red Item icon.
- Yellow Item icon: present — three yellow wrench icons.
- Green Item icon: none visible.
- Blue Item icon: none visible.
- The cyan/blue illumination along wall seams, floor edges, and panels is decorative environmental lighting. Those areas lack the discrete colored badge and white mechanical silhouette used by the yellow Item icons, so they are not blue Item icons.

OTHER MARKS
- Red angular outlines beneath/around the room title appear to be floor or graphic decoration rather than Item icons.
- Small glowing red rectangular wall panels appear environmental/decorative, not red Item icons.
- The black rounded shapes around the tile are cutout/connector or masking geometry, not printed game symbols.

PARTIALLY VISIBLE OUTSIDE THE TARGET TILE
- Lower-right: another large white question mark on a dark hexagonal panel belonging to a neighboring tile.
- Right edge near the middle: a clipped pale cream curved fragment from another neighboring tile’s symbol; too little is visible to identify it confidently.
